node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-one linear-color exclusion
node.statement: On all five official next-to-maximal order-one rows, the colored Frobenius interpolant on the reduced roots cannot have degree one. If E(W)=aW+b, its injective colors all satisfy the quadratic -(b^p+a^(p+1))X^2+(1+b^(p+1))X-b=0, contradicting the six or fourteen distinct colors required.
node.notes: Complete exclusion of degree one only. Combined with the m=8 constant-color theorem, the active h=7 branch starts at color degree two; h=15 still has a constant-color chamber.
